newsitem.title: ITALY: Brcko under international supervision to 1998.
newsitem.headline: Brcko under international supervision to 1998.

text.p: An American arbiter said on Friday the contested strategic northern Bosnian town of Brcko would be placed under international supervision pending a final decision on the town next year.

"No winner is being announced today...We want international supervision for Brcko for not less than one year...to allow for a reduction of tensions," Roberts Owen said. "We will make a final choice no later than March 1998."

"We are not yet convinced that any of the candidates are sufficiently stabilised to take on the situation," he told a news conference after talks with the international community's High Representative for Bosnia, Carl Bildt.

Brcko, which lies on the Sava River, sits on a narrow land corridor which links eastern and western halves of Serb-controlled territory in northern Bosnia and was seized by the Bosnian Serbs early in the 1992-95 war.
The dispute over who should control it almost caused talks which ended the conflict to collapse in November 1995.
"It is very possible that the outcome could be that Brcko could become a special district of Bosnia-Herzegovina," he said.
